title: 第11章 悟空天庭求援太白金星失言第12章 公事公办天庭作风
slug: 西游反正很无聊随便打个劫呗
lines: “师傅，我好一些了！”
离开禁魔之地，孙悟空的伤便已经好了七七八八了。
尝试着想要站起来。
右腿上传来钻心的剧痛。
“猴哥到底发生了什么事？真武将军怎么跑了？”
沙僧不合时宜的问道。
“我也不太清楚……”
当时孙悟空已经被打晕，后面的事情他真的不知道了。
“真武将军离开的时候是怎么说的？”
“他说他突有感悟，想要突破！”
“我看他就是不想帮我们而已……”
猪八戒冷哼道。
之前他早就把牛吹下了。
真武将军不但没有赢那强盗，而且还逃走了。
“猴哥，我再继续请其他帮手，这次一定要把二十八星宿请来！”
猪八戒想着，自己和二十八星宿素来交好，去的话，应该也会受到一热情招待吧。
孙悟空突然间想到了什么？
真武大帝的道统在房间，猪八戒在那里，顶多就是耽误几天。
二十八星宿可是在天上。
要是让这呆子在天上胡吃海喝，那岂不是要等上几年。
“算了！
你且好生照顾师傅，我去找帮手吧！”
真武将军说他突有感悟，想要突破。
差不多是不想沾这潭浑水了。
他的确可以这样躲，不过有的人却是躲不过了。
孙悟空瘸着腿，直接跳上了筋斗云。
“猴哥带我一个，带我一个……”
猪八戒想要上前跟上。
唐僧叫住了他。
这一次真武将军居然临阵脱逃，唐僧不能说什么，只能迁怒于猪八戒了。
孙悟空直接一个跟头飞到了九重天。
刚站稳脚！
右腿就传来了钻心的剧痛。
虽然他金刚不坏之身。
但是想要恢复也得花个两三天。
那可是真疼啊！
“不好！
齐天大圣来了！”
领班的天将看到了孙悟空的到来，对身后的士兵小声的说道。
content_en:
"Master, I'm feeling better!"
After leaving the Forbidden Demon Land, Sun Wukong's injuries were already somewhat healed.
Trying to stand up.
There was a heartbreaking pain in my right leg.
"What happened to Brother Monkey? Why did General Zhenwu run away?"
Sha Monk asked inappropriately.
"I'm not sure either..."
Sun Wukong had been knocked unconscious at that time, and he really didn't know what happened next.
"What did General Zhenwu say when he left?"
"He said he had a sudden enlightenment and wanted to make a breakthrough!"
"I think he just doesn't want to help us..."
Zhu Bajie snorted coldly.
He had blown the bull off a long time ago.
General Zhenwu not only failed to defeat the robber, but also escaped.
"Brother Monkey, I will continue to invite other helpers, and this time I must invite the Twenty-Eight Constellations!"
Zhu Bajie thought that he and the Twenty-Eight Constellations had always been on good terms, so if he went there, he would also receive a warm reception.
What did Sun Wukong suddenly think of?
Emperor Zhenwu's Taoism was in the room, and Zhu Bajie was there. It would only delay him for a few days at most.
The twenty-eight constellations are in the sky.
If this idiot is allowed to eat and drink freely in the sky, wouldn't it be necessary to wait for several years?
"Forget it!
You just take good care of the master, and I'll go find a helper! "
General Zhenwu said that he had a sudden enlightenment and wanted to make a breakthrough.
I almost don’t want to get involved in this muddy water.
He can indeed hide like this, but some people can't.
Sun Wukong limped and jumped directly onto the somersault cloud.
"Brother Monkey, take me one, take me one..."
Zhu Bajie wanted to step forward and keep up.
"Bajie..."
Tang Seng stopped him.
This time General Zhenwu actually escaped from the battle. Tang Seng could not say anything but vented his anger on Zhu Bajie.
………………
Sun Wukong somersaulted and flew to the ninth heaven.
Just got a foothold!
There was a heart-breaking pain in my right leg.
Although he is indestructible.
But it will take two or three days to recover.
That really hurts!
"Not good!
The Monkey King is here! "
The foreman Tianjiang saw Sun Wukong's arrival and whispered to the soldiers behind him.
